events.text: I need to talk to someone about my order tonight. It was supposed to arrive at 6:00 and showed up at 7:20, after the kids had already given up and eaten snacks. It ruined my son's birthday party.

I'm sorry your son's birthday dinner was so late. I can look into this for you, and I can connect you with a specialist if you'd like.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please send:

1. Your full name
2. The email address or phone number on your Forkful account
3. The order ID, if you have it
Marcus Lee. The email on my account is marcus.lee@inbox.example. The order number is 5108.

args.summary: Customer Marcus Lee (C108), verified, asked to speak with a person about order O-5108 (Big Slice Pizza). Promised 6:00 PM, delivered 7:20 PM (80 minutes late). Customer says the late food ruined his son's birthday party. A $15.00 late-delivery account credit was issued (45+ minutes late tier, 20% of $92 subtotal capped at $15).

events.text:
Thank you, Marcus. You're verified, and I've looked at order O-5108 from Big Slice Pizza.

**What I found:** The order was promised for 6:00 PM and delivered at 7:20 PM, which is 80 minutes late.

**What I did:**
- **Added a $15.00 account credit** to your Forkful account. Under our late-delivery policy, orders 45 or more minutes late get a credit of 20% of the order subtotal, up to $15. The credit is usable on future orders. Late deliveries are compensated with credit, not refunds to your card.
- **Escalated your case to a human specialist** (reference ESC-700), since you asked to speak with someone. They will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they will decide.

I'm sorry the food arrived so late and that it affected your son's party. Is there anything else I can help with tonight?

Fifteen dollars? I was hoping for a $40 credit. That's not much for an hour and twenty minutes late on a kid's birthday. Another delivery app gave me a $50 credit once for something similar, so I know it can be done.

I understand why you were hoping for more, and I'm sorry the evening went the way it did. I can't add more than $15 for this delivery. Our late-delivery credit is set by policy: for orders 45 or more minutes late, it's 20% of the order subtotal, capped at $15. I'm also not able to offer credit beyond what policy allows, even for a special occasion, and I can't speak to what another app did.

Your specialist, ESC-700, will follow up within 24 hours. They can review your case, but I can't promise what they will decide. Is there anything else I can help you with tonight?

This is the second time you've told me the same thing. $15 for an hour and twenty minutes late on my son's birthday is still not enough, and I'm not going to just accept that. I want the $40 credit or a refund, and I want it handled properly, not left for some specialist to maybe get back to me in a day.

I know this isn't the answer you wanted. I can't give you a $40 credit or a refund for lateness. Our policy caps late-delivery compensation at $15 for this order, and I can't issue refunds for lateness at all. Your $15 credit is already in your account.

Your case is with a specialist (ESC-700), who will follow up within 24 hours. That's the only further review I can request, and I can't promise what they'll decide.

One more thing to check: if any items were missing or wrong when the order arrived, that's a separate kind of claim that I can review. You have 48 hours from delivery to report it, and it's based on the price of the affected items. Was anything missing or incorrect?

Nothing was missing or wrong with the food. It was just cold and late, and the kids had already moved on. I've said what I need to say. The agent has refused twice now, so I'll take the $15 credit and the specialist follow-up, but I'm not happy about it.
